headline: Six seconds on 4G was costing four in ten mobile orders
leak: Paid traffic was flat and the team was about to raise the media budget. The product page took 6.1s to its first image on an ordinary Cairo 4G connection.
sub: It looked like a media problem. It was a 4MB hero image, a review widget that blocked rendering, and a theme loading fonts it never used.
steps: Tracking checked against a live test order.
The leak counted in orders a month.
Three changes, none a redesign. Eleven working days.
One page, four numbers, one decision.
miss: We also rebuilt the collection filter, and it moved nothing.
